use_case: TaraHome blog cover for a homeowner guide to Home Assistant server downtime and fallback controls
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: TaraHome blog cover, landscape 3:2
Primary request: Create a clean photorealistic editorial image about a home remaining understandable and usable when its local smart-home server is unavailable.
Scene/backdrop: A warm, lived-in residential living room at quiet early evening, pale plaster walls, an oak sideboard, linen upholstery, and restrained dark forest-green ceramic accents.
Subject: In the foreground on the oak sideboard is a small realistic unbranded matte-charcoal mini computer used as a local home-automation server, with its single tiny status light visibly dark and its short power connector resting neatly beside it. In the same continuous room, an adult household member calmly reaches to use the ordinary rotary switch on a freestanding table lamp; the lamp is beginning to glow, showing that normal physical control still works. Keep the person secondary and show only a natural torso/arm/hand interaction, not a posed portrait.
Style/medium: premium natural editorial residential photography, believable real home, not futuristic
Composition/framing: wide three-quarter room view with the mini computer, lamp, and realistic hand all within the central safe area; enough breathing room for clean 16:9 and 16:10 center crops; no split scene or collage
Lighting/mood: soft blue-hour window light balanced with warm lamp light, calm and reassuring, natural color, subtle depth of field
Materials/textures: real oak grain, matte metal, woven linen, glazed ceramic, ordinary plaster, believable cable and plug details
Constraints: realistic hand anatomy, realistic lamp switch, realistic mini-computer proportions and ports, correct perspective, no unsafe wiring, no brand marks, no product logos, no text, no letters, no headline, no title, no watermark
Avoid: wall-mounted light-switch close-up, phone or tablet, screen, dashboard, floating UI card, translucent panel, inset frame, progress bar, chart, graph, arrows, network or routing lines, glowing data paths, fake diagram elements, sci-fi glow, generic AI infographic, duplicated fingers, impossible cables, dramatic red warning lights, staged stock-photo smile, excessive clutter
